cases.explain: «разных земель» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

cases.explain: «безлюдным дорогам» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

cases.explain: «народном собрании» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
